description: Update an existing billing project in your organization. Only the fields you provide are changed (PATCH semantics). You can rename the project, update its description, change its status, toggle which billing types are allowed (TM/Fix/OVH), and set per-type hour limits. Discover ids with find_billing_work - never ask the user for an id.

billing_types.description: Comma-separated list of billing types to allow on this project. One or more of: TM, Fix, OVH. Replaces the entire set — include all types you want to keep.

fix_hour_limit.description: Fixed-price hour limit for this project (0 = unlimited).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

ovh_hour_limit.description: Overhead hour limit for this project (0 = unlimited).

project_id.description: Id of the project to update (required). Must be a project in your organization.

status.description: Project status. One of: Active, OnHold, Completed, Cancelled.

tm_hour_limit.description: T&M (Time & Materials) hour limit for this project (0 = unlimited).

name: update_project
